create_PolynomialFeatures_transform: create a PolynomialFeatures transformer that generates polynomial interaction features from input data
test_PolynomialFeatures_single_feature: test PolynomialFeatures on a single feature up to degree 3 with various degree and bias configurations
test_PolynomialFeatures_two_features: test PolynomialFeatures on two features up to degree 3 with interaction_only and include_bias options
test_PolynomialFeatures_csr_sparse: test PolynomialFeatures CSR sparse matrix input produces correct sparse output matching dense transform
test_PolynomialFeatures_csc_sparse: test PolynomialFeatures CSC sparse matrix input produces correct CSC sparse output matching dense transform
create_SplineTransformer_basis: create a SplineTransformer that generates B-spline basis features with configurable degree and knot placement
test_SplineTransformer_unity_decompositi: test that B-spline basis functions sum to 1 across all features for uniform and quantile knots
test_SplineTransformer_extrapolation: test SplineTransformer constant linear and error extrapolation modes produce correct predictions
test_SplineTransformer_periodic: test SplineTransformer with periodic extrapolation fits periodic curves and maintains smoothness
test_SplineTransformer_missing_values: test SplineTransformer handles NaN values correctly with zeros encoding strategy
test_SplineTransformer_feature_names: test SplineTransformer generates correct feature names with bias and custom input names
test_SplineTransformer_kbins_equivalence: test that degree-0 SplineTransformer with quantile knots is equivalent to KBinsDiscretizer one-hot encoding
test_PolynomialFeatures_feature_names: test PolynomialFeatures generates correct feature names for degree 2 and 3 with custom input names
test_PolynomialFeatures_array_api: test PolynomialFeatures array API compliance across different namespaces devices and dtypes
test_csr_index_overflow: test CSR polynomial expansion index overflow promotion to int64 for large feature counts
